title: Spaghetti Carbonara
author: Claude
description: The Roman classic: silky egg-and-pecorino sauce, crisp guanciale, and plenty of black pepper. No cream.
steps: Boil the spaghetti in salted water.
Crisp the guanciale in a pan.
Whisk egg yolks with grated pecorino and pepper.
Toss drained pasta with guanciale, then the egg mixture off the heat.
